title: Markdown to HTML
description: Renders Markdown content as HTML, either from inline content or external source

sanitize.visualReason: Strips unsafe HTML from the rendered output. Safe Markdown, like the showcase sample, renders the same either way.

breaks.description:
Turn every single newline in the Markdown into a line break (
). Off by default, so hard-wrapped source flows as ordinary paragraphs.

autoLiveRender.description: Render each fenced HTML example in the Markdown as a live component above its code. Set to false for Markdown you did not write, such as an issue body, so its examples stay as code.
autoLiveRender.visualReason: Decides whether fenced HTML examples render live. Markdown with no html fence -- the showcase sample -- looks the same either way (#1723 declared it).

setup: Combined: with sanitize, with gfm
